newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin to discuss wage delays with prime minister.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin to discuss wage delays with prime minister.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin is due to discuss the government's progress in paying off wage arrears to the military and public sector workers at a meeting with his prime minister on Wednesday, a government spokesman said.
Igor Shabdurasulov said Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin would travel to Karelia to meet Yeltsin, who is in the picturesque northwestern region on holiday.

The two men would also discuss the government's progress in reforming natural resources monopolies, including gas giant Gazprom and electricity supplier United Energy Systems (UES), before they are reviewed at a government session on Thursday.
"One might say that it will be a summing-up session in the context of previous government sessions on Gazprom and RAO UES and a forthcoming session on the Transport Ministry," said Shabdurasulov.

Yeltsin, concerned by the possible political fallout from the entrenched wage delays, has ordered the government to pay off overdue wages to the military by September and clear state debts to public sector workers by the end of the year.
